rule: Preserve the exact V25/V23 establish_distal_support reference. During raise_body implement the frozen R10AO law: preserve or improve each joint deficit from 0.02 rad headroom; require total deficit progress while any deficit remains; rank by worst deficit, total deficit, then partial-support standing-height cost, with epsilon 1e-12.
fallback: On absent positive bearing, undefined horizontal heading, or any explicit geometric/headroom refusal, retain the exact reason and use the validated V23 load-seeking reference computed from this same fresh observation. Do not cache contact masks or commands. No fallback is represented as a successful headroom plan.
selection_rationale: R10AO verified 597 admissible one-step targets and three no-bearing refusals on the 600 exposed R10AM inputs. No selected virtual move is downward. The 492 geometry-cost increases while recovering headroom are intentional and must remain visible; one-step geometry proves neither tracking nor convergence.
input_validation: Reuse exact-S169 V25 mathematical descriptor, observation clock, joint/contact/COM and quaternion admission before searching. This kernel does not perform native source, ownership, energy, task-session, or terminal admission; those remain required at composition.

population.selection: All 600 nonterminal R10AM observations in original order; terminal observation excluded.

finite_work: 90 candidates and original bounded IK/free-foot placement, plus bounded V25/V23 validation/reference work. No optimizer, world, direct body command or physical stepping.
validation: Compare every native candidate count, filter count, selected mode, scale, blend, deficit, cost and joint target against the independent R10AO model on all 600 exposed inputs.
Verify deterministic recomputation, source preservation and unchanged support-establishment targets.
Reject invalid phases, clocks, descriptor, joint/contact arrays and nonfinite inputs; explicitly cover absent bearing and undefined heading.
Check deficit/ranking controls and strict receipt serialization; run the full existing release library tests.
